summary: Agi Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing that subsidiary Agibank closed its third FIDC issuance, FIDC Agibank III, totaling R$2.1 billion in Class A quotas across two series. The Brazilian closed-end receivables fund is backed by INSS payroll-deductible loan credit rights, matures in 132 months, and pays CDI plus 1.05% annually, rated AAA.br by Moody's Local. Oliveira Trust administers, with Oliveira Trust Servicer managing and Agibank Asset Management co-managing. This is routine funding diversification, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle apply.
